## History

Gog is a decorative item or figure who was packed away in a box under the spare-room bed at Patty's Place. They remained stored there as [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends returned to [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) for their sophomore year to settle into the house alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and the resident cats.
